scope: Validated adjacent SingleSubst in static TrueType GSUB ligature extraction; not a shaping engine or subsetting replacement
preservation: Existing Unicode candidate policy matches independent fontTools oracle
Single substitutions are structurally validated, not applied or used to invent Unicode
Negative delta uses modulo 65536; input and output glyph IDs validated against maxp
Malformed coverage/counts/offsets/output IDs and inconsistent extension types never return partial native mappings
Cancellation and aggregate word/coverage work budget are retained
Saved PDF text and pixels checked across post 1/2/3 and GSUB 1.0/1.1 finite profiles

limitations: No removal of optional fonts extra: actual subsetting and uncovered font profiles still need fontTools
Flags/context, other lookup kinds, variations and CFF retain established fallback
Finite synthetic corpus and one renderer do not prove arbitrary font/shaping or independent-renderer acceptance
